summary: Biohaven Ltd. filed an 8-K Item 8.01 disclosing Amendment No. 2 to its existing Equity Distribution Agreement with J.P. Morgan Securities LLC, increasing the aggregate offering amount to $350 million in an at-the-market equity offering program of common shares. This is a routine shelf takedown amendment with no fixed price, premium, or board recommendation. The filing does not represent a special situation such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring; it is an incremental equity facility update.
